evidence: The written determinant identity gives sum n_F F = 4I2. Trace makes n_R divisible by four; the positive quadratic form at (2,1) bounds n_R by 16/5. Thus every exact word has n_R=0 and eight calls. Exact matrix-entry enumeration of 1287 multisets gives five necessary profiles; six full formal fixtures and 48 R-substitution controls corroborate the proof.
